revenue_growth.source: Analyst assumption: growth decelerates from FY2026 +65.5% (215,938 vs 130,497) as the base gets large and AI data-center capex normalizes; not a forecast from filings.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: slight fade from FY2026 60.4% (130,387/215,938) for competition and pricing pressure.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: FY2026 effective rate ~15.1% (pretax 141,450 less net income 120,067, acc. 0001045810-26-000021), nudged up for global minimum tax.

da_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2026 D&A/revenue 1.3% (2,843/215,938), rising slightly with capex.

capex_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2026 capex/revenue 2.8% (6,042/215,938), modest increase for capacity investment.

wacc.source: CAPM: Rf 4.86% (US Treasury 10Y, 2026-11-06) + beta 1.50 (Damodaran US Semiconductor unlevered cash-corrected 1.5046, relevered at NVDA D/E ~0) x ERP 4.46% (Damodaran US, 2026-02-16) = ~11.6% cost of equity; debt weight negligible (debt 8,468 vs very large market cap); rounded to 11.5%.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: below the 10Y Treasury yield of 4.86% and near long-run nominal GDP growth.

net_debt.source: financial_statements derived net_debt = total debt 8,468 (acc. 0001045810-26-000021) - cash 10,605; short-term investments not reported in the tool output for FY2026 (null), so net cash is likely understated; reviewer should check marketable securities in the 10-K.
